display.name: GitHub Copilot Chat
display.description: Usage, cost drivers, latency and tool activity for GitHub Copilot Chat, built from the OpenTelemetry traces the Copilot Chat extension exports. Use the Service picker to scope to one or more rollouts. Answers: how many tokens are we spending and on which model, how much is served from the prompt cache, how fast is the first token, which tools does the agent call, and what is failing. Token panels are scoped to chat spans because the invoke_agent span carries a roll-up of its children and would otherwise double count.

display.name: Service
display.description: Filter to one or more Copilot Chat services

display.name: Activity by Agent
display.description: Which internal Copilot agents are running. Background agents such as title generation and summarizeVirtualTools spend real tokens without any visible chat turn.

display.name: Avg Input Tokens per Call
display.description: Average prompt size per model call. Rising values mean the agent is carrying more context into each turn.

display.name: Prompt Cache Hit Rate
display.description: Share of input tokens served from the prompt cache. Cached input is billed at a large discount, so this is the single biggest lever on Copilot cost.

display.name: Cached Input Tokens
display.description: Input tokens read from the prompt cache rather than reprocessed.

display.name: Model Call Latency
display.description: End-to-end duration of chat completion spans, p50 through p99.

display.name: Model Calls
display.description: Number of chat completions requested from the model.

display.name: Conversations
display.description: Distinct chat conversations, counted on gen_ai.conversation.id.

display.name: Errors Over Time
display.description: Copilot spans with an error status, most often a tool that failed rather than the model itself.

display.name: Finish Reasons
display.description: How model responses terminated. A rising share of length means answers are being truncated by the token limit; tool_calls means the model handed control back to the agent.

display.name: MCP vs Built-in Tools
display.description: Split of tool calls between MCP server tools (names prefixed mcp_) and Copilot's built-in tools. Shows whether your MCP servers are earning their place in the tool list.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS AND gen_ai.tool.name NOT REGEXP '^mcp_'

display.name: Reasoning Tokens
display.description: Output tokens spent on internal reasoning by reasoning-capable models. Billed as output but never shown in the chat.

display.name: Recent Errors
display.description: Individual failing spans with their status message. Click through to the full trace to see the conversation turn that produced the failure.

display.name: Model Calls Over Time
display.description: Chat completions per model over time. Useful for spotting when Copilot silently switches you to a different model.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.model EXISTS

display.name: Activity by Operation
display.description: Breakdown of Copilot spans across chat, execute_tool, invoke_agent and embeddings.

display.name: Token Usage Over Time
display.description: Input, output, cached-input and reasoning tokens over time. Cached input is a subset of input, not an additional charge.

display.name: Tokens by Model
display.description: Which model is consuming the token budget. Copilot routes different tasks to different models, so this rarely matches the call-count split.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.model EXISTS

display.name: Tool Calls
display.description: Number of tools the agent executed, such as read_file, grep_search or an MCP tool.

display.name: Tool Calls by Name
display.description: Which tools the agent actually reaches for. Shows what kind of work Copilot is trusted with.

display.name: Tool Latency (p95)
display.description: Slowest tools by p95 execution time. Long-running terminal commands and remote MCP calls dominate here and directly stall the agent.

display.name: Total Tokens
display.description: Input plus output tokens across Copilot model calls. Copilot emits no total_tokens attribute, so this sums the two components, scoped to chat spans to avoid double counting the invoke_agent roll-up.

display.name: Time to First Chunk
display.description: Seconds until the first streamed token arrives. This is what the developer actually perceives as Copilot being slow, independent of total response length.
